meta.note: Single source for the Results section (rendered by js/results.js). All numbers are simulation results. Edit values here, reload the page; no code change needed. Text fields accept **bold**.

intro: The same missions are flown twice — once by classic guidance, once by the pilot — on **3 unseen maps, 2,304 paired missions per condition**, with engine-outs, navigation drift and blind cameras injected.

headline_stats.title: Landings on unseen terrain
headline_stats.body: Pilot success over 2,304 paired missions on 3 maps it never saw; classic guidance scored 97.66 %.

headline_stats.title: Better than classic guidance
headline_stats.body: 95 % CI [+0.2, +1.3], exact McNemar p = 0.019: 32 missions only the pilot landed, 15 only classic.

headline_stats.title: Mean miss on touchdown
headline_stats.body: Successful landings at normal failure rates (≈10 m harsh), terminal ~2 km of a simplified 3-DOF simulation.

headline_stats.title: Parameters in the pilot
headline_stats.body: A transformer residual on ZEM/ZEV guidance; with zero authority the lander flies pure physics.

cards.title: Normal failure rates
cards.note: 32 missions only the pilot landed, 15 only classic landed. The whole gain comes from one map: Site 42 (95.05 % → 97.01 %, p = 0.008); Shoemaker and DM2 are ties. Replicated byte for byte on the Mac mini.

cards.title: Accuracy
cards.note: Successful landings only. This is the **terminal descent phase (from ~2 km) in a simplified 3-DOF simulation**, not a full descent from orbit.
cards.source: runs/lander/benchmark.json, per-map miss_m; parameter count from the checkpoint

cards.title: Planner: the backup won
cards.note: Mean simulated mission success of the chosen cell, held-out Site 23, 7 dates, 672 candidates. The learned planner did not beat the Navigator ranking, so the **Navigator ranking ships**. (A logistic baseline scored 15.2 % here but lost clearly on validation.)

cards.title: Final exam · Site 23 (flown once)
cards.note: A **tie**: 1,024 paired missions per condition; normal 11 only-pilot vs 11 only-classic landings (exact McNemar p = 1.000); harsh 19 vs 21 (p = 0.875). The pilot is **not better** than classic guidance on the final exam.
cards.source: lander_mini/runs/lander/benchmark_site23_final.json (flown once on the Mac mini, 15 Nov; never re-flown)

cards.title: At our landing site (mission rehearsal)
cards.note: Every mission targets the one cell the Navigator planned on Site 23 for 2027-03-17 (slope 4.3°, no hazard); 512 paired missions per condition. Harsh rates: pilot 99.02 %, classic 99.22 % (p = 1.00). Miss p95: pilot 29.0 m, classic 32.7 m. A rehearsal of one planned cell after the final exam, **not an exam**.
cards.source: runs/lander/mission_rehearsal.json (python -m worldmodel.lander.mission_bench rehearsal --n 512, reconstructed from missions_per_condition), nominal
